description: Hệ thống Báo giảng và Thống kê Tiết dạy Tự động - Trường PTDTNT THPT Đam San

scripts.dev: npm run dev:web & npm run dev:api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w packages/contracts && npm run lint -w packages/config
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck -w packages/config && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w apps/web && npm run test:unit -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/config && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
